title: The CLI never silently drops fields a backend lacks
description:
graphql_authoring quietly drops newer fields when the backend schema lacks them: _schema_lacks_newer_reference_fields (star, capture, public-feed and card fields), _schema_lacks_medium_fields (medium, evidenceLevel, playlistUrl, mediumFeedKey, captureReason, contentNeededKey, thumbnailPath), and headStageKey on Item writes (has_head_stage_key / _without_head_stage_key). That is a CLI-newer-than-backend workaround and goes against the AGENTS.md rule: schema drift is fixed by deploying, never by reduced-field fallbacks. Ryan's rule: a CLI newer than a site backend must fail loudly. The CLI refuses and names the version it needs: 'this CLI needs a backend at 5.X or later'. Remove the fallbacks, the per-process flags and their tests; no retry without the fields. Gherkin required (narrative, complete).

Feature: The CLI never silently drops fields a backend lacks
  Scenario: A newer reference field the backend lacks
    Given a site backend whose Reference type has no starRating
    When I run a command that writes starRating
    Then the command fails and the message says this CLI needs a backend at 5.X or later
    And no write is sent without the field
  Scenario: A newer reference field on a read
    Given a backend whose schema lacks captureState
    When a command selects captureState
    Then it fails with the same backend-version message and does not retry with a reduced selection
  Scenario: The medium field family
    Given a backend whose input type has no medium, evidenceLevel, playlistUrl, mediumFeedKey, captureReason, contentNeededKey or thumbnailPath
    When I save a Reference that names any of them
    Then the save is refused with the backend-version message
    And the fields are never stripped and the save is never repeated without them
  Scenario: The head stage key
    Given a backend whose Item type has no headStageKey
    When I write an Item that carries headStageKey
    Then the write is refused with the backend-version message
    And the key is never silently omitted
  Scenario: A current backend
    Given a backend that has every field
    When I run the same commands
    Then they behave as before
  Scenario: The message names the version
    When any of these refusals is shown
    Then it reads 'this CLI needs a backend at 5.X or later' with the real version, and exits non-zero
